svg.title: Jam Jam API
svg.desc: The Jam Jam mushroom mascot plays the ukulele next to a song sheet and a chord diagram. A song goes in, a songbook comes out as PDF, ChordPro, MIDI, MusicXML or synced lyrics.

g.text: Turn a song into a songbook,
Files, links or text in. Chords, lyrics and structure out,
as PDF, ChordPro, MIDI, MusicXML, synced lyrics and more.
Amazing grace! how sweet the sound,
That saved a wretch like me!
